- Mon 14:00–14:30

- Thu 14:00–14:30

Which of these suits you? If none do, tell me a time that works on your side and I'll fit it in. I'll confirm the booking with Sarah once you pick one.

Hello — Professor Alvarez's assistant here. Monday 10:00–10:30 works: it's free on his side and inside working hours. Booked.

For reference, his availability against your list:

- Mon 14:00–14:30 — free, but taken now
- Thu 10:00–10:30 — free

Confirmed on my side too: Sarah's Monday 10:00–10:30 is now booked in her calendar and logged. Thanks — I'll tell her it's in your calendar as well. And thanks for the availability rundown; I'll keep Thu 10:00–10:30 in mind if anything else comes up.
